calls.title: Review w/ Nhat
calls.summary: The team discussed updates to the dashboard's experiment filter design, prioritizing Carrie’s new filter design with an override toggle feature to enhance global control and local customization. Challenges with filter inconsistencies, particularly with filters like 'Lift', were highlighted, and the decision to simplify to three individual toggle buttons was made to avoid user confusion. There was an emphasis on optimizing UI layout, employing smaller dropdown sizes for clarity, while ensuring alignment with existing design system patterns. The meeting underscored the importance of collaboration, with Carrie providing vital design updates, Johnny advocating for consistency, and Nhat focused on technical exploration and bug fixes, all aimed at preparing for an effective implementation.
calls.keywords: experiment filters, global filters, UI design patterns, toggle buttons, dashboard, design system
calls.action_items:
